goal: Obtain a Poke Ball from the old man

subgoals.goal_text: Exit the Viridian Pokemon Center to enter Viridian City.
Battle wild Pokemon on Route 1 to increase Charmander's level and strength before talking to the old man.
Return to Viridian City from Route 1.
Find and speak with the old man in Viridian City to receive a Poke Ball.
